# [postcss][postcss]-normalize-url [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-normalize-url.svg?branch=master)][ci] [![NPM version](https://example.invalid/js/postcss-normalize-url.svg)][npm] [![Dependency Status](https://example.invalid/ben-eb/postcss-normalize-url.svg)][deps]

> [Normalize URLs](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/normalize-url) with PostCSS.

## Install

With [npm](https://example.invalid/package/postcss-normalize-url) do:

```
npm install postcss-normalize-url --save
```

## Example

### Input

```css
h1 {
    background: url("http://example.invalid:80/image.jpg")
}
```

### Output

```css
h1 {
    background: url(http://example.invalid/image.jpg)
}
```

Note that this module will also try to normalize relative URLs, and is capable
of stripping unnecessary quotes. For more examples, see the [tests](test.js).

## Usage

See the [PostCSS documentation](https://example.invalid/postcss/postcss#usage) for
examples for your environment.

## API

### normalize([options])

Please see the [normalize-url documentation][docs]. By default,
`normalizeProtocol` & `stripFragment` are set to `false`; `stripWWW` to `true`.
